## Prepared, not active
Select dedicated Header Auth (x-project-room-key) for context, and the existing Slack OAuth connection for delivery. No secrets belong in this workflow JSON. Deploy shared rooms and the scoped read-only bridge first. Configure only rooms explicitly approved for this channel and both recipients. Verify a manual test appears in #chief-channel, then publish with release approval.

Daily at 5 AM Eastern. ChatGPT Meetings and automatic calendar matching are disconnected. This reports saved room evidence. Execution payload saving is disabled. Automatic retries are off: after uncertain Slack delivery, inspect the channel before replay. Static date guard prevents later successful scheduled duplicates, not concurrent executions or manual tests. Configure an n8n error workflow for operational failures.
